title: Machine learning derives a three-gene glutamine-metabolism signature in osteoarthritis
summary: A WGCNA and LASSO pipeline on multi-tissue GEO datasets selected a three-gene signature (F13A1, IRS2, RELA), which was checked by RT-qPCR in 62 subjects (31 with osteoarthritis, 31 controls) and plasma metabolomics. Plasma creatine emerged as an independent predictor of severity. The validation cohort is small and WGCNA is a conventional method, so the machine-learning contribution is the LASSO selection.
ai_technology: WGCNA with LASSO feature selection on transcriptomic data
organization: College of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China; Chongqing Jiangjin District Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Chongqing, China

evidence.tested: RT-qPCR validation in 62 subjects and plasma metabolomics.
evidence.unknown: Diagnostic accuracy in larger cohorts and causal role of the genes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO selected the signature genes from the multi-omics analysis.
